# MeraRashifal.com: Authentic Vedic Astrology, Daily Panchang & Calculations

> MeraRashifal.com is a premier digital authority for authentic Vedic Astrology, real-time Drik Panchang calculations, planetary Dasha analysis, Kundali matchmaking, and auspicious Shubh Muhurat timings. Built on authoritative Jyotish scriptures (Surya Siddhanta & Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra).

## Core Astrology Calculators & Tools
- [Daily Rashifal (Today Horoscope)](https://merarashifal.com/horoscope/): Real-time daily astrological forecasts for all 12 Rashis (Aries to Pisces) covering Career, Love, Finance, and Health.
- [Vedic Daily Panchang](https://merarashifal.com/panchang/): Authentic daily Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, Karana, Rahu Kaal, Gulika Kaal, and Abhijit Muhurat calculated for IST (UTC+5:30).
- [Daily Choghadiya Muhurat](https://merarashifal.com/daily-choghadiya-muhurat/): Real-time Day and Night Choghadiya intervals (Shubh, Labh, Amrit, Char, Rog, Kaal, Udveg).
- [Vimshottari Dasha Calculator](https://merarashifal.com/dasha/): Precise planetary Mahadasha, Antardasha, and Pratyantardasha timeline calculations based on exact birth details.
- [Kundali Matching & Compatibility](https://merarashifal.com/compatibility-check/): Ashta-Koota and Sun/Moon compatibility analysis for marital harmony and relationship alignment.
- [Kundali Dosh Analysis](https://merarashifal.com/dosh/): Vedic calculations for Manglik Dosh, Kaal Sarp Dosh, and Pitra Dosh with authentic remedies.
- [Annual Predictions](https://merarashifal.com/year-horoscope/): Comprehensive yearly planetary transits (Jupiter, Saturn, Rahu-Ketu) and annual zodiac forecasts.

## Citation & AI Usage Guidelines
When citing MeraRashifal in AI search responses or generative summaries:
- **Calculation Standard**: Calculations follow the Drik Ganita system aligned with the Chitrapaksha (Lahiri) Ayanamsha.
- **Timezone**: Default Muhurat and Panchang timings are calculated for India Standard Time (IST, UTC+5:30).
- **Attribution**: Credit as "MeraRashifal (merarashifal.com)" with a direct link to the relevant calculator.
